02Why should I care?

Size doesn’t make you invisible.

Automated tools sweep the internet all day, looking for known weak spots. They don’t check how big you are first. If your website, logins or app are online, they’re in range.

03Could we actually be exposed?

Most weak points can’t be seen from the inside.

Your website is the part you can see. Behind it sit logins, APIs, cloud storage and the odd forgotten test server. Small teams rarely have time to check every corner, and that’s perfectly normal.

04What do you actually do?

We look the way an attacker would, with your permission.

That’s VAPT. A vulnerability assessment finds known weaknesses across your surface. A penetration test then tries them, carefully and inside the agreed scope, to show what they would really allow.

05What does a real problem look like?

Small gaps can line up into one big one.

An admin page open to the whole internet. A password reset that can be guessed. An API that hands back another customer’s records. A storage folder left public. Alone, each can look minor. Together, they form a path, and finding it is what testing is for.

06Then what?

Then it’s a short list, in order of priority.

No scare tactics and no hundred-page dump. You get what matters most first, what it means for your business, and how to fix it. Fix it, and the path closes.

07What would you check for us?

Tell us what you run. We’ll show what we’d look at.

Pick everything that applies. Not sure what you have? Choose that one and we’ll help you map it.

08How does it work, and what’s my part?

Three steps. Your part is spelled out in each.

We keep it simple, and we tell you exactly what we need from you at every stage.

  1. Your part

    Tell us what you run, and give written permission for us to test it.

    Our part

    We confirm scope, timing and ground rules in writing, and send a quote before any work begins.

  2. Your part

    Carry on as normal. We’ll only reach out if we need something, such as a test account.

    Our part

    We scan for known weaknesses, then test the promising ones by hand, staying inside the agreed scope and window.

  3. Your part

    Read the summary. We’ll walk you through it and answer questions.

    Our part

    We write up every finding with evidence, what it means for your business, and how to fix it.

09What do I receive?

A report your whole team can read.

Every finding is explained twice: once for whoever runs the business, once for whoever fixes it. Flip the switch to see both.

  • AA short summary written for owners
  • BFindings ranked by priority
  • CFix guidance your developers can act on
  • DA walkthrough call to go through it together

10Can I trust you?

How we work, in writing.

Trust is earned, so instead of badges, here is exactly how we behave. Hold us to it.

  1. 01

    Only with your written permission

    We test what you’ve authorized, inside the window we agree. Nothing else.

  2. 02

    No surprises

    Anything risky is discussed first. If something looks unstable, we stop and tell you.

  3. 03

    Honest severity

    If it’s minor, we say it’s minor. We don’t inflate findings to look impressive.

  4. 04

    Your data stays yours

    What we see while testing is treated as confidential and kept only as long as the report needs it.

  5. 05

    Plain words, always

    Every finding comes with an explanation a non-engineer can follow.
